subject: Platform fee split, on-call credits and air-gapped ops bundle — clarification
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Cho <sarah.cho@lumoshealth.com>, Tom Lin <tom.lin@lumoshealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.cho@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Platform fee split, on-call credits and air-gapped ops bundle — clarification

Hi Sarah / Tom —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Following up with a concise list of items we need clarified to finalize the Commercial Draft and SOW:

1) Platform fee split: you asked whether the platform fee can be split across a consumption floor + fixed amortized component. We can do a 60/40 split (60% amortized platform fee, 40% consumption floor) but we need a committed baseline for the amortization. Please confirm the baseline GPU-months you expect for year 1.

2) On-call / SRE retainer credits: we proposed a 3-month on-call credit applied to month 1–3 of the retainer if you convert to a 12-month reserved capacity. Confirm you want the credit applied to the retainer cost or to the platform fee.

3) Air-gapped delivery: for the air-gapped appliance variant we will include a separate implementation SOW (patching windows, on-site runbook training). Does the Lumos security team require KMS/HSM integration on Day 1 or can that be Phase 2?

Attached: Support_Tiers_2026.pdf (tier definitions) — will follow up with a redlined SOW after I get the baseline and the credit allocation preference.

Ask: can you reply with the baseline GPU estimate and credit allocation preference by EOW Friday? That will let us lock the platform fee amortization schedule.

Thanks,
Sean
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0124

On Tue, Apr 28, 2026 at 09:12, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks again for the time yesterday. Following up with a concise list of items we need clarified to finalize the Commercial Draft and SOW:

Thanks Sean — quick responses inline below.

1) Baseline: for year 1 we expect roughly 18 GPU-months as a baseline for the initial pilot (we may scale to ~45 GPU-months if pilot converts). Will that work for amortization math?

2) Credits: procurement preference is to have credits applied against the platform fee (keeps our monthly ops budget clean). If Redwood insists on applying to the retainer we need that spelled out in the commercial terms.

3) KMS/HSM: Lumos security requires FIPS-validated key storage and integration with our on-prem HSM on Day 1 for any air-gapped deployment. Phase 2 is risky for us — please assume Day 1 HSM integration as part of implementation.

Also: we need a short list of what the Tier 2 SRE retainer covers (on-call hours, response SLA, runbook updates). The attached procurement checklist wants evidence of SOC 2 logs access patterns — can you include a short paragraph in the SOW about audit log retention and who has console access?

Best,
Sarah Cho
Director, Infrastructure — Lumos Health

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.cho@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 29 Apr 2026 08:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Lumos clarifications — suggested commercial response

FYI — drafted a reply we can send to Lumos. Key points / concessions:

- Platform fee: propose a 30% reduction on the amortized platform fee component if Lumos signs a 12-month reserved capacity at the 45 GPU-months anchor (this gives us predictability and meets their amortization ask). The effective amortization baseline will be 36 GPU-months for pricing math (midpoint of pilot->scale).

- Credits: offer to apply the 3-month credit to the platform fee per Lumos preference, but tie the credit to execution of the PO within 30 days and DocuSign completion.

- On-call retainer: include a Tier 2 SRE retainer definition in SOW_v2.docx (attached). Proposed on-call window: 24/7 paging, 2-hour P1 response SLA, monthly runbook updates, up to 8 engineering hours / month incident remediation included; additional hours billed at T&M.

- KMS/HSM: confirm Day 1 HSM integration is supported but will require a security engineering SKU for integration and vaulting procedures; propose a one-time integration fee (listed in SOW_v2). Suggest we include a statement in the SOW around audit log surfaces and a 90-day retention by default with extended options.

Draft reply to Lumos (send after you OK):

> Hi Sarah / Tom —
>
> Appreciate the clarity. We can proceed on the following terms: 30% reduction to the amortized platform fee if Lumos commits to a 12-month reserved capacity anchored at 45 GPU-months; the amortization baseline used for pricing will be 36 GPU-months. We will apply the 3-month credit against the platform fee provided the PO and signed agreement are executed within 30 days of the SOW.
>
> Our attached SOW_v2.docx outlines Tier 2 SRE retainer coverage and the KMS/HSM integration scope and one-time integration SKU. We will include an audit log retention paragraph (90 days default) and a console access matrix for SOC 2 evidence.
>
> If that sounds reasonable, we can prepare the DocuSign package and redline the commercial exhibit for procurement.
>
> Thanks,
> Ben

Attached: SOW_v2.docx (redlined with SRE & HSM integration line items).

Ben
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Platform fee split, on-call credits and air-gapped ops bundle — Lumos counter

Ben / Sean —

Thanks for the rapid turnaround and for SOW_v2. Procurement is empowered to accept a modified version of your proposal with the following adjustments summarized below:

1) We accept a 20% reduction on the amortized platform fee (rather than 30%) with a 12-month term and a baseline anchor of 40 GPU-months.

2) We request the 3-month credit be applied to the platform fee as proposed, and that the credit shows up as a line item on the first invoice for transparency.

3) Day 1 KMS/HSM integration is non-negotiable — Lumos will provide the HSM details during implementation. Any integration SKUs or additional one-time fees need to be capped at a not-to-exceed amount; please include that in the commercial exhibit.

4) Payment terms requested: Net 30 from invoice. PO will be raised upon receipt of the DocuSign package.

If Redwood can amend the commercial exhibit to reflect the 20% reduction, the capped HSM integration fee, and Net 30 terms we will sign and issue a PO within 5 business days. Please send the updated DocuSign link and the final SOW.

Regards,
Lumos Procurement (on behalf of Lumos Health)
procurement@lumoshealth.com
